text:
maria_csm: Morning team — quick Pinecrest weekly health check. Heads-up: tokens down ~12% WoW, but their throughput (RPS) looks up QoQ (~+40%). p90 latency spiked to ~420ms in us-east yesterday, error rate ticked to 0.9% (baseline ~0.2%). Spend MTD is $12.4k (+18% MoM). Onboarding status: streaming integration is partially live (beta). Any immediate red flags?

telemetry-bot: automated snapshot -> https://redwood.internal/reports/pinecrest/weekly
```
tokens_weekly: 3.1M (-12% WoW, +9% QoQ)
throughput_rps_avg: 120 (QoQ +40%)
p50: 78ms  p90: 420ms  p99: 1.2s
errors_total: 0.9% (timeouts + transient 5xx)
spend_mtd: $12.4k (+18% MoM)
active_users: 1.9k (streaming sessions ↑)
cache_hit_rate: 56% (target 85%)
```

ajay_success: Noted. Streaming tends to increase open connections and smaller per-request token slices — that can reduce cache effectiveness and raise tail latency. Do we know which model variant they're hitting? Any recent rollout?

sam_eng: I'm checking deploys now. No major model swaps in the last 7d, but I see increased parallel sessions starting 2026-02-19 ~03:00 UTC. Can run `redwood trace --customer pinecrest --since 24h` and look for KV cache misses.

kelly_onboard: We had the onboarding call yesterday; Pinecrest turned on streaming for the chat ui but didn't apply recommended batching or client-side rate limits yet. They also moved to the new SDK which defaults to smaller chunk sizes. I flagged this during the call.

ajay_success: If cache_hit_rate is 56% that's the biggest lever. Recommend enabling prefix/KV caching and increasing batch window slightly for streaming adapters. For immediate relief: 1) enable fallback model with lower latency for critical endpoints 2) increase cache TTL for stable prompts 3) throttle concurrent sessions by user tier.

maria_csm: Good. Renewal risk: low today, but if spend keeps rising and latency impacts SLAs we should escalate. Finance already got an overage alert; I'll loop in account exec after we have the optimization plan.

sam_eng: Quick commands I ran (paste):
```
# recent tail logs for Pinecrest
redwood logs --customer pinecrest --env prod --since 24h --level warn | tail -n 200
# check cache metrics
redwood metrics get --customer pinecrest --metric cache_hit_rate --range 7d
```
I see a cluster of `KVCacheMiss` errors correlated with p90 spikes.

kelly_onboard: Action items: 1) schedule 30m follow-up with Pinecrest for batching guidance (owner: kelly_onboard, ETA: today EOD) 2) engineering to enable prefix cache + monitor for 24h (owner: sam_eng, ETA: 4h) 3) success to draft cost optimization note for customer (owner: ajay_success, ETA: tomorrow AM).

maria_csm: I'll prep a short summary for the AE and PO: current state, actions, and risk. Also flag: ask Pinecrest if there's a spike in concurrent users (they mentioned a trial run).

telemetry-bot: scheduled alert: p90 > 400ms in us-east — alert created (ID: ALRT-20260219-2330).

ajay_success: If engineering needs quick experiments, we can enable transient canary that routes 10% of traffic to a lower-latency variant to buy time.

sam_eng: Will run a canary and monitor costs. If cache improves to >75% we should see p90 drop under 200ms.

maria_csm: Perfect. I'll update Pinecrest and book the follow-up. Thanks all :thumbsup:

kelly_onboard: :eyes:
